tone_target: Interstellar — practical-feeling analog/digital hybrid tech, teal/amber grade, volumetric light, quiet gravity, camera that holds rather than cuts frantically.

M.description: 50s, close-cropped silver hair, weathered calm face, deep navy flight suit with a worn embroidered insignia, thin wire-frame glasses that catch console light. Moves deliberately, speaks in short declarative lines. Quiet authority, not flashy.

F.description: Late 20s, short dark hair, olive field jacket over a grey thermal, sleeves often pushed up, expressive hands mid-gesture. Leans in when explaining. Makes the complex feel obvious.

Y.description: Mostly camera POV / over-the-shoulder silhouette. When face is needed: plain flight jacket, breath faintly visible, hands holding a slate/tablet. Audience surrogate.

sets.name: Ops Control Room
sets.description: Circular chamber, wraparound curved monitor bank, central holo-table, warm amber practicals against cool blue ambient wash, dust motes in light shafts, deep shadow falloff at frame edges.

sets.name: Cockpit/Ship interior
sets.description: Tighter, analog toggle switches under glass, small round viewports, warm interior light shifting to red-alert wash during tense beats.

sets.name: Screen inserts (math)
sets.description: Pure black background, glowing cyan-white equations, no clutter — legibility over decoration.

camera_grammar.description: Handheld-but-stabilized, subtle breathing sway — this is the audience.
Classic over-the-shoulder, soft foreground blur of Y's shoulder/collar.
Symmetric framing with Y implied just off-camera between them.
Reserved only for revelations/emotional beats, never for teaching beats.
Close on Y or F's face watching a screen, keeps humans present during math-heavy beats.

visual_style_guide.grade: Teal shadows, warm amber highlights, light film grain, gentle anamorphic horizontal flare off any screen source.
visual_style_guide.golden_rule: Never let a Manim insert run alone for its full duration. Open on a human gesture toward the screen, hold the insert, close on a reaction.

scenes.beat: Alarm triggers. M: "We're picking up something. It's not noise — it's repeating." Signal freezes as number pairs. Title card: THE SIGNAL.

shots.flux_frame: Massive dish array against a dense starfield, isolated outpost, teal-amber grade, dust and light shafts, wide anamorphic lens
shots.wan_motion: Slow push-in, near-imperceptible, stars hold static

shots.flux_frame: Control room, M and F silhouetted against the monitor bank, one red alarm light beginning to pulse in the background
shots.wan_motion: Camera holds, alarm light pulses on a slow interval

shots.flux_frame: M turns toward camera (Y), alarm glow reflected faintly in his glasses
shots.dialogue: M: "We're picking up something. It's not noise — it's repeating."

shots.wan_motion: Waveform freezes into scrolling number pairs, rack-focus reveals M/F blurred behind

shots.flux_frame: Frozen waveform fills frame, faint cyan glow
shots.wan_motion: Slow push, title card THE SIGNAL fades in over the freeze

scenes.title: Problem stated
scenes.beat: M poses the ordered-pair problem. F reassures Y. Sets up 1.1.

shots.flux_frame: Control room, three consoles, M center-frame, raw (a,b) pairs scrolling on the main screen behind him
M half-turned to camera, gesturing at the scrolling pairs
shots.dialogue: M: "Two numbers per burst. No units, no label. Is it one thing or two?"

shots.flux_frame: Close on the scrolling (a,b) pairs, cyan glow on M's jaw visible at frame edge
shots.wan_motion: Data continues scrolling, slight rack focus onto the numbers

shots.flux_frame: F leans into frame from the side console, addressing camera (Y) directly
M and F both facing camera/screen, contemplative hold, Y implied between them
shots.wan_motion: Slow push-in, sets up cut to math insert

scenes.title: Ordered pair → a+ib
scenes.beat: Manim delivers ordered pair, a+ib, and one merge operation. Human frame before and after.

shots.flux_frame: F points at the main screen, mid-explanation gesture
shots.dialogue: F: "Think of it as one point, not two numbers."

shots.flux_frame: Pure black screen, ordered pair (a,b) plots as a dot on a grid, relabels to z=a+ib, second dot merges: (a,b)+(c,d)=(a+c,b+d)
shots.wan_motion: Manim-native motion: point plots, label morphs, merge animation — no camera movement

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face lit by screen glow, small nod of understanding
shots.wan_motion: Y-POV: F glances back to camera, checking in

shots.flux_frame: M nods once from the background, arms crossed, approving
